liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, which is the whole of the cash liquidity position and excludes undrawn credit lines.
Debt due within one year was reduced by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, so the near-term maturities are covered by cash liquidity without new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments rose by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, equal to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}} of debt, the comparable measure of cash left for debt holders once leases are paid.
Net capex fell by {{net_capex.change@FY2024}} to {{net_capex@FY2024}}, which released cash for debt reduction.

watch_items.text: Cash liquidity: cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue down by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}}.
Maturities: debt due within one year of {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}} is covered by cash liquidity, but the buffer is thinner than a year earlier as cash was used to repay debt.

Interest coverage: coverage eased by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}} as finance costs rose by {{finance_costs.change@FY2024}} to {{finance_costs@FY2024}}, so the cost of debt is rising faster than EBITDA.

Tariffs: the CNMC set the maximum adjusted annual revenue per passenger for 2025 at the same level as the prior year, so aeronautical revenue per passenger of {{aero_revenue_per_passenger@FY2024}} has limited scope to rise through tariffs.
